svg.text: Lab 20 — Configuring Celery Task Retry Behavior
autoretry_for + retry_backoff + max_retries — transient failures retry with exponential delay

g.text: Failed tasks wait longer between each retry — 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s.
After max_retries, the task fails permanently.

svg.text: Client publishes the failing task; Flask returns 202 immediately
WORKER EXECUTION PATH · with retry loop
Worker catches TransientError, schedules a delayed retry, runs again, catches again, doubles the delay

g.text: each retry waits twice as long as the previous one — backoff doubles up to retry_backoff_max
